premise: After the rain a puddle is as wide as a sea; Ladybug captains a leaf boat across it, Frog paddles with her big feet, and Snail is the anchor when the wind blows.
inspiration: Nonsense voyage poems (Lear's The Owl and the Pussy-cat), turned into a puddle crossing where the slow one holds the boat steady.
lesson: Every crew needs someone who holds steady.

en-US.title: Ladybug's Leaf Boat
en-US.text: The rain had stopped and left a puddle as wide as a sea. Ladybug stood at the edge. We're going across, she said. They found a big curly leaf and pushed it in. All aboard! Ladybug {ladybug:hop} hopped on at the front. Captain. Frog {frog:hop} hopped on at the back Paddle. And Snail {snail:pulse} slid on in the middle, heavy and calm. Anchor. Push off! Frog paddled. Swish, swish. The leaf {frog:float x3} bobbed along. Halfway across, a breeze came. Whoosh! The leaf {ladybug:wobble x2} tipped. Ladybug held on. Anchor! she cried. Snail stuck himself down tight, and the leaf went flat and still. On they went. Swish, swish. Bump. Land! Ladybug jumped off. Frog jumped off. Snail {snail:sparkle} slid off last. The other side looked just like the first. But it felt very far away. And that was the best part.

es-ES.title: El barco de hoja de Mariquita
es-ES.text: La lluvia había parado y había dejado un charco ancho como un mar. Mariquita se plantó en la orilla. Vamos a cruzar, dijo. Buscaron una hoja grande y rizada y la empujaron al agua. ¡Todos a bordo! Mariquita {ladybug:hop} saltó a la proa. Capitana. Rana {frog:hop} saltó a la popa y metió sus patazas en el agua. Remo. Y Caracol {snail:pulse} se deslizó al medio, pesado y tranquilo. Ancla. ¡Zarpamos! Rana remó. Chas, chas. La hoja {frog:float x3} avanzó a botes. A mitad del charco, vino una brisa. ¡Fiuuu! La hoja {ladybug:wobble x2} se inclinó. Mariquita se agarró. ¡Ancla!, gritó. Caracol se pegó bien fuerte, y la hoja quedó plana y quieta. Siguieron. Chas, chas. Pum. ¡Tierra! Mariquita saltó fuera. Rana saltó fuera. Caracol {snail:sparkle} bajó el último, como hacen las anclas. La otra orilla era igual que la primera. Pero parecía lejísimos. Y eso era lo mejor.
